analysis.themes: The Zodiac killings destroy the men who can't stop looking — the film is about obsession and the unbearable possibility that some questions have no answer.
analysis.atmosphere: Clinical unease; the horror isn't the murders but the open file, the cipher that never quite yields.
analysis.narrative: A procedural that spans decades and pointedly refuses catharsis — obsession is the through-line, not the killer.
analysis.visual: Fincher's digital precision turns evidence, handwriting, and geography into the film's real subject.
analysis.characters: Graysmith's cartoonist becomes a sleuth because the puzzle eats him; Avery and Toschi are consumed at different speeds by the same unsolved file.
